citations.quote: that involves the simulation of an explicit parametric model for risk-factor changes

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Monte Carlo VaR is the general simulation route: draw many risk-factor scenarios from an explicit calibrated parametric model, full-revalue the portfolio per scenario, and read the alpha-quantile from the simulated loss sample; McNeil Ch.9 §9.2.5 emphasises the cost of per-scenario revaluation.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Monte Carlo VaR — McNeil Ch.9 §9.2.5-§9.2.7
